forum.title: UART does not work with STM32U575
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content: Hi all, I have resolved the problem, 1k impedance resister is too large. It cause unexpected noise on Uart bus. I removed it and it worked, so I will close this thread.
forum.author: BLS_Karo

scraped_replies.html:
If you do not include more details, there are tons of errors that could be in your code.

Attach whole project and we can try to help you.

Error in clocks, setup of otput mux are most common errors that block USARTs; oscilloscope is required to assert that usart is not sending anything ...
